entities.title: Reference renders
entities.summary: Recreates the design's reference scenario and renders every reference state of docs/screens/.
entities.purpose: seed.py fills a fresh local database with the scenario's players, invitations and games through the dev sign-in and the API; retime.py spreads their times over the last week; local_history.py writes a signed-out player's history; render.sh runs the desktop build under Xvfb once per state with the development switches and --shot; contact_sheet.py lays the renders out on one sheet.
boundaries: It needs a local dev server with DEV_LOGIN=1; it never touches the production database.
What "visually correct" means, and the reference scenario, are docs/DESIGN.md's.
